origin: Hero of many tales.

name: Shahryar
origin: King whom Shahrazad beguiles with the tales of a thousand nights and a night.

name: Dalilah

name: Shakashik

origin: Hero in the tale "Ma'aruf the Cobbler and His Wife Fatimah."
